about: Product-specific VST3 component floats, measured from public host APIs. Values are stored VST3 plain values, which need not equal displayed physical units. Component and controller envelopes, unknown float slots and private tails are retained.

layers: stored float32 controls and opaque tail

parameters/Filter Routing.about: VST3 parameter 0. Host display: 0 = Serial; 0 = Serial; 1 = Parallel; 1 = Parallel; 1 = Parallel.

parameters/Filter 1 Characteristic.about: VST3 parameter 3. Host display: 0 = FabFilter One; 1 = Gentle; 1 = Gentle; 2 = Raw; 2 = Raw.

parameters/Filter 1 Response.about: VST3 parameter 4. Host display: 0 = Low Pass; 1 = High Pass; 1 = High Pass; 2 = Band Pass; 2 = Band Pass.

parameters/Filter 1 Slope.about: VST3 parameter 5. Host display: 1 = 12 dB; 2 = 24 dB; 2 = 24 dB; 3 = 48 dB; 3 = 48 dB.

parameters/Filter 1 Enabled.about: VST3 parameter 6. Host display: 0 = Disabled; 0 = Disabled; 1 = Enabled; 1 = Enabled; 1 = Enabled.

parameters/Filter 2 Characteristic.about: VST3 parameter 9. Host display: 0 = FabFilter One; 1 = Gentle; 1 = Gentle; 2 = Raw; 2 = Raw.

parameters/Filter 2 Response.about: VST3 parameter 10. Host display: 0 = Low Pass; 1 = High Pass; 1 = High Pass; 2 = Band Pass; 2 = Band Pass.

parameters/Filter 2 Slope.about: VST3 parameter 11. Host display: 1 = 12 dB; 2 = 24 dB; 2 = 24 dB; 3 = 48 dB; 3 = 48 dB.

parameters/Filter 2 Enabled.about: VST3 parameter 12. Host display: 0 = Disabled; 0 = Disabled; 1 = Enabled; 1 = Enabled; 1 = Enabled.

parameters/Receive Midi.about: VST3 parameter 16. Host display: 0 = Enabled; 0 = Enabled; 1 = Disabled; 1 = Disabled; 1 = Disabled.

parameters/Correct Gain Behavior.about: VST3 parameter 17. Host display: 0 = No; 0 = No; 1 = Yes; 1 = Yes; 1 = Yes.

parameters/Bypass.about: VST3 parameter 18. Host display: 0 = Not Bypassed; 0 = Not Bypassed; 1 = Bypassed; 1 = Bypassed; 1 = Bypassed.
